description: Intent i021 (branch=terminator-write-off-by-one, snapshot s04) is complete with 2 high-confidence findings that settle the recorded f008-vs-f015 contradiction. (1) s04 drivers/edac/versal_edac.c:854-863 inject_data_ue_store: len = min_t(size_t, count, sizeof(buf)) on char buf[6] (no -1) followed by buf[len] = '\0' at line 863 writes buf[6] when the debugfs inject_ue write (registered via edac_debugfs_create_file("inject_ue", 0200, ...) at line 924, .write at :906) supplies count >= 6 — a deterministic 1-byte NUL out-of-bounds stack write. (2) s04 drivers/edac/zynqmp_edac.c:294-311 inject_ue_write: byte-for-byte identical pattern, len = min_t(size_t, count, sizeof(buf)) at 307 then buf[len] = '\0' at 311 on char buf[6], debugfs inject_ue_bitpos (0644) at :359 — same 1-byte stack OOB write. The contradiction is resolved in favor of f015: buf[len] with len == sizeof(buf) is one past the array (valid indices 0..5); f008's 'safe' reasoning was wrong. Evidence: full-function line reads, exact source quotes in the artifact, and an AddressSanitizer reproducer of the exact clamp+terminator lines under $TMPDIR reporting 'stack-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 1'. Tree-wide sweep: 2945 buf[idx]=0 terminator sites enumerated, ~418 count/len/min-clamped triaged; every other min-clamp site in s04 (ath5k/ath6kl/ath9k/ath10k/ath11k/rtw89/amdgpu_pm/toshiba_acpi/ntb_tool/iio/pseudo_lock/regmap-debugfs/aat2870/chipidea/hid-wiimote/spufs/dma-debug/pktgen/kdb/bpf-helpers/etc.) uses the correct sizeof(buf)-1 form and is classified safe with concrete line evidence (e.g. pseudo_lock.c:1257 min(count, sizeof(buf)-1); chipidea/debug.c:83 min_t(size_t, sizeof(buf)-1, count); rtas-proc.c:316-317 cap to MAX_LINELENGTH-1; srm_env.c:101 count >= PAGE_SIZE rejected; kernfs/file.c:316-319 len+1 allocation). Limitations: regex-based sweep may miss terminator indices derived through helper indirection; no in-kernel KASAN run (read-only snapshot), classification rests on bound analysis plus userspace ASan model; both findings are root/debugfs-gated with impact limited to one controlled NUL byte past a 6-byte stack array. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i021.json (snapshots_checked=["s04"]).
